name: ip-cn-fallback-outside-permit-invalid
description: When there is no SAN and an IP permit is in effect, a CN-formatted IPv4 dotted-quad outside the permitted range must be rejected by validators that apply IP CN fallback.
notes: IP CN fallback is not specified by RFC 5280; behavior is implementation-defined.
